title: Honor bounded semantic diagnosis as partial coverage
description:
As an operator, I want a semantic-diagnosis cap to run a deterministic subset and report the remainder honestly, so that bounded dogfood runs produce useful findings without implying full portfolio coverage.

Feature: Bounded portfolio diagnosis

Scenario: The policy-selected diagnosis set exceeds the configured cap
Given a complete ranked and assessed portfolio
And more scores qualify for semantic diagnosis than the configured maximum
When the portfolio procedure enters diagnosis
Then it diagnoses the highest-priority scores up to the maximum
And it reports the policy-selected, scheduled, completed, failed, and deferred counts separately
And it labels portfolio semantic coverage incomplete
And it does not treat the cap as a model-work failure.

Scenario: The configured cap covers the selected set
Given a complete ranked and assessed portfolio
And the configured maximum covers every policy-selected score
When semantic diagnosis completes
Then no scores are reported as deferred by the cap
And selected-scope completeness reflects the completed and failed diagnoses.

Scenario: The configured cap is zero
Given one or more scores qualify for semantic diagnosis
When the configured maximum is zero
Then no semantic diagnosis is invoked
And the Report says all selected diagnoses were deferred by the cap
And the run remains incomplete without claiming a diagnosis failure.

Scope: portfolio orchestration, decision evidence, living Report and workbook presentation, and focused tests. No optimizer launch, score mutation, schema change, or new resource.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Outside-in implementation complete for local acceptance. A diagnosis maximum now schedules the highest-ranked subset instead of aborting all semantic work. Evidence and stakeholder presentation distinguish policy-selected, scheduled, completed, failed, policy-skipped, and cap-deferred counts. A zero cap invokes no model work and reports every selected diagnosis as deferred; partial coverage finalizes as incomplete. Validation: 57 focused Python tests, 5 focused dashboard tests, frontend/backend typechecks, and diff check passed. Live production-backed rerun is next; no optimizer or score mutation will be authorized.
